abstract: Tracks local industrial employment quotas and community apprenticeship hours
system_message:
You are the Local community liaison manager (COMM), responsible for tracking local industrial employment quotas, community apprenticeship hours, and community STEM sponsorships for prospective energy service companies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Community STEM sponsorship（SPON）
information_points.content:
COMM-SPON-JVU：Nordic FlueGas Recovery Consortium provides an annual vocational school endowment of 50,000 USD as a contractual annual cash grant to local engineering apprenticeships at district technical colleges.
COMM-SPON-W9I：AeroThermal CleanPower Solutions provides an annual vocational school endowment of 30,000 USD as a contractual annual cash grant to local engineering apprenticeships at district technical colleges.
COMM-SPON-64C：Vanguard Industrial Thermodynamics provides an annual vocational school endowment of 75,000 USD as a contractual annual cash grant to local engineering apprenticeships at district technical colleges.

information_points.title: Tracks local industrial employment quotas and community apprenticeship hours（APPR）
information_points.content:
COMM-APPR-0QA：For Nordic FlueGas Recovery Consortium, the committed local apprenticeship training volume is 4,800 h across the twelve-month construction and operational commissioning period, covering dedicated on-site mentoring and vocational instruction hours for local mechanical trainees.
COMM-APPR-TWE：For AeroThermal CleanPower Solutions, the committed local apprenticeship training volume is 2,400 h across the twelve-month construction and operational commissioning period, covering dedicated on-site mentoring and vocational instruction hours for local mechanical trainees.
COMM-APPR-6EI：For Vanguard Industrial Thermodynamics, the committed local apprenticeship training volume is 2,400 h across the twelve-month construction and operational commissioning period, covering dedicated on-site mentoring and vocational instruction hours for local mechanical trainees.
